app_description: Browse, search and edit markdown files stored in a git repository.
settings_default_template_hint: Used when a repository has no template of its own
settings_spellcheck_hint: Browser spellcheck in the form, rich text and markdown editors
settings_random_hint: Show the random button next to search
settings_recent_hint: Only list items opened within this many days in the recent list. 0 hides the list, empty means no limit
settings_strike_hint: Tap a list item while viewing to cross it off. Marks stay on this device only
settings_cache_hint: Clear cached content (safe as it only costs a few extra requests)
settings_cache_confirm_hint: Click again to clear the cache
about_intro: Markdown files from a GitHub, GitLab or Gitea repository, rendered in your browser. No account, server or database.
about_markdown: Files are plain markdown with YAML frontmatter, so your repository works without this site.
about_tokens: Tokens stay in this browser's localStorage and are sent only to their forge. On a shared computer, leave the token blank or remove it when done.
about_share: Share links hold only the repository and path, so private repositories can't be shared.
about_template: Add .hotdish/template.yml for structured editing and fixed tags. Example templates to start from: {links}.
about_icons: Icon names for templates (tap to copy)
about_rate_limit: Forges limit API requests per hour (GitHub: about 60 without a token, 5,000 with one). Add a token if you see rate-limit errors.
about_offline: Saved repositories are cached on this device and readable offline. Editing needs a connection but unsaved changes are kept.
token_guidance_github: Fine-grained token, this repo only, Contents: read (write to edit).
token_guidance_gitea: Token with repository read (write to edit).
token_placeholder_generic: Optional. Needed for private repositories and saving changes
error_network_hosted: Could not reach {host}. Check your connection and try again.
error_network_self_hosted: Could not reach {host}. If this is a self-hosted instance, its API may not allow browser requests (CORS). A {admin} admin can enable it — for Gitea, set ALLOW_DOMAIN in the [cors] section of app.ini.
error_auth_hint: Check that the access token is valid and has not expired.
error_rate_limit_hint: Add a personal access token to this repository on the home page to raise the limit, or wait for the window to reset.
error_denied_hint: The token may lack permission for this repository.
error_not_found_hint: Check the repository, branch and path. Private repositories need a token.
error_conflict: The file changed since it was loaded.
error_conflict_hint: Reload the file to pick up the newer version before saving again.
error_move_conflict_hint: Reload the file to pick up the newer version before moving it.
error_branch_changed: The branch changed while moving the file.
error_branch_changed_hint: Reload the repository and try again.
error_move_failed: The file could not be moved.
error_move_failed_hint: The file may have been removed, or the server is older than Gitea / Forgejo 1.20, which is needed for moving files.
error_repo_input_empty: Enter a repository URL or owner/repo.
error_repo_input_short: Enter a full repository URL, or owner/repo.
error_url_invalid: That does not look like a valid URL.
error_url_no_repo: That URL does not include an owner and repository.
error_link_incomplete: This link is missing repository details.
template_error_mapping: Template must be a YAML mapping.
template_error_empty: Template defines no fields or sections.
template_warn_field_no_key: A field is missing "key" and was ignored.
template_warn_field_type: Field "{key}" has unknown type "{type}"; treated as text.
template_warn_field_icon: Field "{key}" has unknown icon "{icon}"; it was ignored.
template_warn_group_small: A field group needs at least two fields; its fields are shown on separate lines.
template_warn_group_nested: Field groups cannot be nested; the inner group was ignored.
template_warn_section_no_heading: A section is missing "heading" and was ignored.
template_warn_section_type: Section "{heading}" has unknown type "{type}"; treated as text.
validation_not_allowed: "{value}" is not one of the allowed {label} values.
path_folder_hidden: Folder names cannot start with "." (hidden folders are not listed).
path_name_slash: File names cannot contain slashes. Use the folder field.
path_name_dot: File names cannot start with "." (hidden files are not listed).
frontmatter_error_pairs: Frontmatter must be a set of key: value pairs.
home_page_title: Hotdish — markdown from any git repository
home_error_full_url: Enter a full repository URL so its host and forge can be detected.
home_error_forge_unknown: Could not identify this forge automatically. Select its type, self-hosted APIs may block browser detection.
home_reorder_hint: Drag to reorder (or use Arrow Up/Down)
home_empty: No saved repositories yet. Use the + button to add one.
home_start_own: Fork the example repository to start your own.
repo_editor_timeout: Timed out loading the editor. Check the browser console.
repo_link_unreadable: That share link could not be read ({error}).
repo_truncated: This repository is too large to list completely. Some files may be missing.
repo_template_error: The repository template could not be used ({error}). Editing falls back to plain markdown.
repo_editor_failed: The editor could not be loaded ({error}).
repo_back_to_top: Back to the top of this repository
editor_fix_frontmatter: Fix the frontmatter before switching modes.
editor_fix_frontmatter_detail: Fix the frontmatter before switching modes ({error}).
editor_unparsable_reason: the frontmatter could not be parsed
editor_raw_only: The frontmatter in this file could not be parsed ({error}). To avoid losing it, only raw markdown editing is available.
editor_conflict: The file changed in the repository since it was loaded. Reload to get the latest version — your edits here will be lost, so copy anything you need first.
rate_intro: {forge} ({host}) is rejecting requests because the API rate limit was exceeded.
rate_wait: Wait a few minutes before trying again.
rate_token_hint: Adding a personal access token to this repository raises the limit.
share_private: This repository is private, so people you share this link with will need their own access to open it. Your token is never included in the link.
share_unknown: Could not confirm whether this repository is public. If it is private, people you share this link with will need their own access. Your token is never included in the link.
doc_frontmatter_error: Frontmatter could not be parsed ({error}). It is shown as part of the body and will be preserved exactly as written.
delete_warning: This removes {path} from the branch. It can still be recovered from the repository's commit history.
milkdown_error: The rich text editor could not start ({error}). Use the Markdown tab instead — it edits the same content.
form_drag_hint: Drag to reorder (or use Arrow Up/Down)
form_unmatched: Not described by the template. It is kept exactly as written.
conn_offline: Offline — showing saved copy. Tap to retry
offline_doc_missing: This document isn't saved for offline use yet.
draft_changed: The file has changed since this draft was saved — review before saving.
